review: Ten final native and nine exact candidate standing frames directly reviewed; before and after feet and targets are identical.
runtime_contract: Test-written schema-2 resident permissions, copies, locked-door denial, save and reconstruction proof in executed scope only.
limits: Matching floor/capsule stations establish no continuous route or sightline.
Twelve native bench bearings establish geometric contact, not capacity or instrument operation.
The original plain-colour scope face remains byte-equivalent in runtime draw attributes, pose and literal material; no waveform or carrier state is introduced.

Initial native inspection rejected 14 retained-display endpoint pairs. Independent triangle checks found boundary contact without penetration; only exact declared boundaries are admitted at the unchanged 30 micrometre tolerance.
Initial native views exposed hidden knobs and cropped crowns. Corrected control depth, framing and bulb profiles were regenerated in Blender; earlier frames remain diagnostic.

The first runtime had ten short-ray valve misses. A read-only diagnostic retained those failures and compared the same collision faces with longer rays. Only the test ray origins changed; geometry, collision faces, helper and tolerances stayed fixed.
Valve shelving, charging stock, speakers, aerial spools, cabinet and counter retain their original owners and remain coarse.
Captures, wrapper receipts and inert reports promote no requirements. Human acceptance, whole-shop acceptance and V2 completion remain open.
